scenarios.name: Stories lifetime

scenarios.name: Scene multi-category

scenarios.name: Image / permissions

scenarios.name: Collection / Following

scenarios.name: Stock thresholds

scenarios.name: Empty / many

scenarios.name: Independent moderation gate

scenarios.name: Draft Product
